title: Fatehpur Sikri
summary: Fatehpur Sikri in Uttar Pradesh is the palace-city Akbar founded in 1569 and held as his capital. The Archaeological Survey of India says he moved his court there from Agra for 13 years, 1572 to 1585, to honour the Sufi saint Sheikh Salim Chishti, and calls it the first planned city of the Mughals. The Columbia Encyclopedia says it was largely deserted by 1605 for lack of water.

uncertainty.note: Founding is 1569 in the Columbia Encyclopedia and the court move is 1572 to 1585 in the ASI; the capital ends in 1584 (Columbia) or 1585 (ASI).
